name: Sidocode Storewide Discount for WooCommerce
author: Abidemi Kusimo

sections.description:
SidoCode Storewide Discount for WooCommerce lets you apply a global percentage discount across your entire store in seconds.

No complicated rules. No bulk editing. Just set your discount and go live.

Perfect for:
– Flash sales
– Seasonal promotions (Black Friday, Christmas, etc.)
– Quick storewide discounts
– Clearing stock

Key Features

  • Apply a global percentage discount to all products
  • Set start and end dates for automatic scheduling
  • Works with simple and variable products
  • Optional sale badge display on products
  • Customisable badge text (e.g. “20% OFF”, “Save 15%”)
  • Lightweight and fast — no performance impact
  • No complex configuration required

Why Use This Plugin?

Most WooCommerce discount plugins are complex and overkill.

This plugin focuses on one thing:
quickly applying a storewide discount without hassle.

If you want a simple way to run a sale, this is for you.

Future Plans

  • Advanced targeting options
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sidocode-storewide-discount directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Storewide Discount.
  4. Enable the discount and set your percentage.
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes. The discount is applied to all variations.

Can I schedule the sale?

Yes. You can set start and end dates for your discount.

Does it overwrite existing sale prices?

The plugin applies a calculated sale price based on the regular price.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and designed for performance.

Can I customise the sale badge text?

Yes. You can change the badge text and include the discount percentage dynamically.
